# bko-holt load plan for layout.json
# Source: host-1, Gentoo Linux, UEFI boot with grub, dumped 2026-11-12T13:40:16Z
#
# Disks:
#   vda (16 GiB) -> /dev/sdq

# ---- partition ----
# vda -> /dev/sdq: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vda1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2097152 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2099200 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=33550336 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: gpt
label-id: bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512
table-length: 128
first-lba: 2048
last-lba: 33554398

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=2097152, type=C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
/dev/sdq2 : start=2099200, size=31453184, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003
EOF
udevadm settle

# ---- assemble ----
mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt/keys
# cryptroot unlocks with the key file /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/keyfile1.key on the restored system; until that's restored, a temporary key
dd if=/dev/urandom of=/run/bko-holt/keys/cryptroot bs=64 count=1 status=none
# LUKS2 on /dev/sdq2
cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --type=luks2 --cipher=aes-xts-plain64 --key-size=512 --sector-size=512 --offset=32768 --pbkdf=argon2id --pbkdf-memory=1048576 --pbkdf-parallel=4 --pbkdf-force-iterations=10 --hash=sha256 --luks2-metadata-size=16384 --luks2-keyslots-size=16744448 --uuid=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004 --key-file=/run/bko-holt/keys/cryptroot /dev/sdq2
cryptsetup open --key-file=/run/bko-holt/keys/cryptroot /dev/sdq2 cryptroot
mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt/lvm
# volume group vg0: its metadata, for pvcreate and vgcfgrestore
cat > /run/bko-holt/lvm/vg0.vg <<'EOF'
vg0 {
	id = "bkoLVM-0000-0000-0000-0000-0000-000002"
	seqno = 3
	format = "lvm2"
	status = ["RESIZEABLE", "READ", "WRITE"]
	flags = []
	extent_size = 8192
	max_lv = 0
	max_pv = 0
	metadata_copies = 0
	physical_volumes {
		pv0 {
			id = "bkoLVM-0000-0000-0000-0000-0000-000001"
			device = "/dev/mapper/cryptroot"
			status = ["ALLOCATABLE"]
			flags = []
			dev_size = 31420416
			pe_start = 2048
			pe_count = 3835
		}
	}
	logical_volumes {
		root {
			id = "bkoLVM-0000-0000-0000-0000-0000-000003"
			status = ["READ", "WRITE", "VISIBLE"]
			flags = []
			creation_host = "archiso"
			creation_time = 1794489871
			segment_count = 1
			segment1 {
				start_extent = 0
				extent_count = 2560
				type = "striped"
				stripe_count = 1
				stripes = ["pv0", 0]
			}
		}
		swap {
			id = "bkoLVM-0000-0000-0000-0000-0000-000004"
			status = ["READ", "WRITE", "VISIBLE"]
			flags = []
			creation_host = "archiso"
			creation_time = 1794489871
			segment_count = 1
			segment1 {
				start_extent = 0
				extent_count = 256
				type = "striped"
				stripe_count = 1
				stripes = ["pv0", 2560]
			}
		}
	}

EOF
pvcreate --devicesfile '' --devices /dev/mapper/cryptroot --uuid bkoLVM-0000-0000-0000-0000-0000-000001 --restorefile /run/bko-holt/lvm/vg0.vg /dev/mapper/cryptroot
vgcfgrestore --devicesfile '' --devices /dev/mapper/cryptroot --file /run/bko-holt/lvm/vg0.vg vg0
vgchange --devicesfile '' --devices /dev/mapper/cryptroot --activate y vg0

# ---- format ----

# dm-1: ext4

tune2fs -r 131072 /dev/mapper/vg0-root

# ---- mount ----
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target
mount -t ext4 -o noatime /dev/mapper/vg0-root /mnt/bko-target

mount -t vfat -o umask=0077 /dev/sdq1 /mnt/bko-target/boot

RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id latest /mnt/bko-target
# the atimes the restore set, for boot to put back after its reads

cryptsetup luksAddKey --key-file=/run/bko-holt/keys/cryptroot /dev/sdq2 /mnt/bko-target/etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/keyfile1.key
cryptsetup luksRemoveKey /dev/sdq2 /run/bko-holt/keys/cryptroot
# / with the source's atime options (rw,noatime), for host-only dracut's rootflags=
mount -o remount,noatime /mnt/bko-target

sh -c '[ -s /run/bko-holt/atimes.before ] || { mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before; }'

sh -c 'rm -rf /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices; [ ! -d /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices ] || { cp -a /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices && touch -r /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices.parent; }'
mount --rbind --make-rslave /dev /mnt/bko-target/dev
mount --rbind --make-rslave /proc /mnt/bko-target/proc
mount --rbind --make-rslave /sys /mnt/bko-target/sys
mount --rbind --make-rslave /run /mnt/bko-target/run
